title: Figure 19: Penning trap laboratory setup with injection apparatus and control racks
description: Color photograph of a laboratory showing a cylindrical Penning trap apparatus behind a chain-link safety cage at center, injection apparatus at left, and racks of electronic control instruments at right, with yellow-and-black hazard tape on the floor. Caption: "Figure 19. Penning Trap With Trapping Volume of 1,000 Cubic Centimeters (center), Injection Apparatus (left) and Controls (right) (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)." Text covers positron storage and the Brillouin density limit.
